title: DECISION: external pinning endpoints must use HTTPS
description: config.rs validate() rejects any external pinning service whose endpoint URL does not start with 'https://'. Sending article CIDs to a remote service over plain HTTP exposes the CID list (metadata: what articles exist) and the bearer token to network observers. The check is enforced at config load, and a dedicated test (external_pin_service_http_endpoint_rejected) confirms the rejection.
